Name: Thought Shard
Description:
Putting a finger to your head, you pull a memory, an idea, or a message from your mind and transform it into a tangible string of glowing energy called a thought shard, which persists for the duration or until you cast this spell again. The thought shard appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you as a Tiny, weightless, semisolid object that can be held and carried like a ribbon. It is otherwise stationary.

Alternatively, you can imbue the thought shard into a Small or Tiny object, where it remains for the duration.

If you cast this spell while concentrating on a spell or an ability that allows you to read or manipulate the thoughts of others (such as detect thoughts or modify memory), you can transform the thoughts or memories you read, rather than your own, into a thought shard.

Casting this spell while holding a thought shard allows you to instantly receive whatever memory, idea, or message the thought strand contains (casting detect thoughts on the strand has the same effect). Alternatively, a creature who knows it is a thought shard while in contact with it can attempt an Arcana check (DC equal to your spell save DC), and on a success may read the shard’s contents.
